title: Didn’t get out one cookie
text: Didn’t get out one cookie. I’ve been using a cookie press from the 1950’s for 30 years. Perfect every time. I’m away from home and bought this to make a large number of cookies fast. Didn’t have trouble putting together, could simulate action before putting dough in. The dough was not too hard. I kept squeezing the trigger and it kept moving but no dough came out. Took it apart and the metal part had broken the plastic piece that pushes the dough. Very disappointing to say the least.
